# mtl5_bench capability card -- i7-12700k

The platform benchmark's capability cards for the `i7-12700k` machine described on the
[benchmark systems](../systems.md) page: every operation family, measured against this
machine's FMA peak and memory bandwidth (#721). This page shows the latest published
`medium` session; every session's raw results stay in the data directory.

Repeatability: 843 of 858 entries within +-5% of the previous session, measured straight after it, without a cold boot (other work was running on this host) on the same commit (median ratio 0.999 to 1.003 per run; benchmarks/compare_sessions.py). Relates to #721, #737 and #885.
